purpose: Unit-by-unit comparison between the two historical scorers' own recorded conclusions and Evaluation V2's independent judgment. The historical rows are READ from their frozen artifacts; no historical matching code is imported or re-executed.

headlineCounts.note: The three numbers are not directly comparable as pass/fail rates: the historical scorers measured whether ANY unit at a structural address was flagged, while V2 measures whether the ground-truth CLAIM is represented or honestly surfaced. The per-unit table below is the meaningful comparison.
